newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First announces coalition talks' timetable.
newsitem.headline: NZ First announces coalition talks' timetable.

text.p: New Zealand First announced on Tuesday it would be holding coalition talks this week with both the National and Labour Parties.
The first coalition discussions for the week would be held on Tuesday October 29 at 5 p.m. with Labour.
On Wednesday, NZ First would be meeting with National at 10 a.m. and with Labour at 2 p.m.
Thursday's schedule is similar, with National meeting with NZ First at 10 a.m. and Labour negotiations starting at 2 p.m.
All meetings would be at held at Parliament.
